verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-run setup wizard. Model credentials are supplied by setting environment variables such as OPENAI_API_KEY, which is the hand-configuration the story wants to avoid. The admin panel for configuring settings and adding chat models is an adjacent post-install control, not a guided onboarding flow covering credentials, channels, and defaults.

support.subject: As an everyday user, a first-run wizard walks me through model credentials, channels, and defaults instead of hand-editing config files
